scope: Hancom Hangul 2024 Style dialog in project synthetic native-abcd-delete.hwpx

observations.screenshotObservation: The returned pixels showed another foreground application, while accessibility described Hwp and its Style dialog. Unrelated pixels and titles were not persisted.
observations.sdkInspection: The exposed methods are native-bound; @oai/sky resolves through an injected facade, not a readable local module at workspace cwd.

attempts.result: Error: failed to activate captured window

attempts.method: js_reset → initialize → list_apps → get_window → text-only state → perform_secondary_action(element_index:1,action:Raise)
attempts.result: Error: failed to activate captured window

processDiagnostic.limitation: Codex and Hwp process tokens were read. The underlying Computer Use helper token and native activation return trace were not exposed or inspected.

confirmed: Hwp responds and its process and all observed Codex processes run in session 3 at medium integrity (0x2000).
Both list APIs expose only the parent document, while accessibility exposes the Style dialog.
Text-only capture and a JavaScript kernel reset did not restore modal activation.
conclusions.hypothesis: The bridge targets the parent while the owned modal is open, or binds captured/accessible state to an unsuitable activation target. Exact internal cause is unconfirmed.
conclusions.nextRequired: Tool-provider correction or a supported API exposing the owned modal and accurate capture/input binding. No Jueony source change can repair the injected Computer Use bridge.
excludedActions: No native helper launch or custom protocol client
No security or foreground-lock settings changes
